messages:
Arjun CSM: FYI HelioEdge triggered a big generation + rerank load during A/B test this morning, pinging because renewal is in 6 weeks and their monthly spend shot up. :wave:
Leah FinOps: Noted. Received an anomaly alert at 06:12 UTC. Their billable token rate jumped ~4.5x for a 3-hour window. I've pulled the spike snapshot.
Sam Enablement: They mentioned turning on an extended-search flag in testing. I advised to revert but they kept it for traffic reasons. I'll prepare a safe-test config to propose.
Rita Data: Quick breakdown: majority of tokens from rerank endpoint `POST /v1/rerank` with long negative prompt lists. Top user agent: `integration-tests/helm-2.3`.
Ops Bot: alert: anomaly-detect: HelioEdge spike logged, ticket CS-8120 opened (owner: Arjun CSM).
Arjun CSM: We need a concise QBR slide blurb + remediation log for the deck. Can @Leah produce short-term forecast and a suggested concession?
Leah FinOps: I'll draft a 30-day forecast at current surge rates and a conservative projection assuming test rollback. Suggestion: offer 100k promo tokens + conditional extra 75k if they adopt safe-test config and set rate limits. Will include a delta table.
Sam Enablement: Safe-test config items I'll push to their sandbox: limit rerank list length to 25, switch ranking model to `compact-rank-v2` for tests, and set `client_rate_limit = 2000/min`. I'll also add a demo checklist.
Rita Data: I'll add tracing spans and annotate the sample requests. Early signal: 65% of the extra cost came from a single test harness job. I'll attach CSV of offending requests to CS-8120.
Arjun CSM: Action list: Leah (forecast + concession), Sam (safe-test push + howto), Rita (logs & CSV), Arjun (customer outreach + QBR blurb).
Leah FinOps: Blockers: none. I'll also propose an automated watch rule: pause promo top-up if usage > 250k tokens/day for 3 consecutive days.
Sam Enablement: I'll draft the one-pager for tomorrow's sync and include a short script they can run to validate the safe-test config.
Arjun CSM: QBR deck language (draft): "Unexpected test harness rerank surge during pre-prod A/B tests. Mitigation: sandbox throttles, model switch, and targeted promo to smooth onboarding; recommended follow-up: implement safe-test guardrails and review test harnesses."
Ops Bot: note: CS-8120 updated with attachments by Rita Data.
Arjun CSM: Thanks all. Please upload your deliverables to CS-8120 and the QBR prep folder. Close this thread after upload. :white_check_mark:
